commands.name: Validate historical snapshot
Run Node tests and dashboard contracts
Validate snapshot and generate three independent strategies
commands.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from research.idea_engine.v3.short_term_daily_bars import validate_snapshot
from research.idea_engine.v3.short_term_trade_plan import DEFAULT_OUTPUT, atomic_write, generate

prices = json.loads(Path("data/short-term-daily-bars-v1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
candidates = json.loads(Path("research/results/v3_1/idea-engine/latest-candidates.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
symbols = [row["ticker"] for row in candidates.get("candidates", [])]
result = validate_snapshot(prices, symbols, benchmark="QQQ", as_of=prices.get("as_of"))
if not result["valid"]:
    raise SystemExit("daily short-term snapshot invalid: " + "; ".join(result["errors"][:10]))
atomic_write(DEFAULT_OUTPUT, generate(as_of=prices.get("as_of")))
PY

commands.name: Mark scan failure without replacing results
Check monthly cadence
commands.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
path = Path("research/results/phase6s/shadow-observation-governance-report.json")
report = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else {}
latest = report.get("latestObservationDate")
latest_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(latest.replace("Z", "+00:00")) if latest else None
due = latest_dt is None or (datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() - latest_dt.date()).days >= 7
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(f"SHADOW_UPDATE_DUE={'true' if due else 'false'}\n")
print(f"shadow_update_due={due}")
PY
